trends.name: Iran Strait of Hormuz Control & Oil Markets
trends.summary: Iran asserting control over Strait of Hormuz post-ceasefire, capping vessel transits and demanding cryptocurrency tolls, with ~55% chance of normalization before July 1. Oil volatility collapsed as ceasefire odds of $120+ crude fell from 88% to 24%, with prices falling below $96/barrel on peace talks momentum.

trends.name: US GDP Growth Collapse & Economic Slowdown
trends.summary: US GDP growth plummeted to 0.5% in Q4 2025 from 4.4% in Q3, far below expectations. Personal income declined in February 2026 with real incomes at lowest since December 2022, while real spending remains subdued despite elevated core prices, signaling recession risks.

trends.name: AI Subscription Monetization & Enterprise Competition
trends.summary: OpenAI launching $100/month ChatGPT Pro subscriptions to compete with Anthropic's enterprise dominance. Anthropic's Mythos model rollout signals aggressive AI monetization race, with Meta's Muse Spark also entering market. Core question: can premium AI subscriptions sustain valuations and generate meaningful revenue?

trends.name: Israel-Hezbollah Conflict Intensification
trends.summary: Netanyahu explicitly rejects ceasefire with Lebanon despite talks, signaling continued military operations against Hezbollah. Israeli coalition losses mount as Bennett and Eisenkot gain seats on hawkish platform; Israeli military expects incoming rocket attacks. Contradicts broader Middle East peace narrative affecting oil and defense stocks.

trends.name: Data Center Expansion Delays & Infrastructure Bottlenecks
trends.summary: 30-50% of US data centers scheduled to open in 2026 now expected to delay or cancel. Maine becomes first state with data center ban, creating infrastructure constraints amid AI boom. Supply chain bottlenecks threaten AI capex plans and could pressure semiconductor/cloud stock upside.

trends.name: Meta AI Monetization & Profitability Questions
trends.summary: Meta's Muse Spark AI model launch raises critical question: can generative AI drive revenue growth? Despite aggressive AI investments, path to profitability unclear as competition intensifies. Market pricing in uncertainty about whether AI capex translates to earnings growth or shareholder returns.

trends.name: Anthropic's Enterprise Dominance & Market Share
trends.summary: Anthropic consolidating enterprise market share with security-focused positioning, contrasting with consumer-focused competitors. Mythos model rollout and security implications suggest institutional customers prefer Anthropic's approach, creating competitive moat for B2B AI.

trends.name: US Troop Withdrawal From Europe & NATO Uncertainty
trends.summary: Trump administration considering withdrawing US troops from Europe, signaling potential NATO realignment. Defense contractor outlook shifts as geopolitical strategy pivots; European allies face security uncertainty amid Middle East instability.

trends.name: Airline Industry Margin Compression & Fee Escalation
trends.summary: American Airlines raising bag fees for basic economy passengers amid inflationary pressures. Reflects broader airline industry strategy to offset fuel costs and labor inflation; consumer pushback risk amid economic slowdown.

trends.name: Corporate Layoffs & Labor Market Cooling
trends.summary: Disney planning layoffs of up to 1,000 employees as cost pressures mount across entertainment sector. Combined with AI-driven workforce displacement (47% of college students reconsidering majors due to AI), labor market shows structural shift toward lower headcount models.

trends.name: Oil Market Volatility & Geopolitical Pricing Collapse
trends.summary: Oil prices collapse as ceasefire optimism erodes geopolitical premium; Polymarket odds of $120+ crude crashed from 88% to 24%. Markets repricing Middle East risk as peace talks progress, but Israeli escalation and Iran Strait control create asymmetric upside risk.

trends.name: Salesforce & Enterprise Software Adoption Shift
trends.summary: Salesforce positioned to benefit from AI boom despite skepticism, but customer priorities are rapidly changing. Enterprise software vendors face margin pressure as customers demand AI-integrated solutions, shifting purchasing patterns away from traditional CRM focus.
